_comment: Site registry. How each site exposes discounts, what works, what doesn't. Update every run. A starting point, not a whitelist.

sites.name: Running Warehouse
sites.discount_exposure: Brand clearance pages work reliably. catpage-SALEM.html / MRSHOE / Mens_Running_Shoes_Sale all 404 as of 2026-09. Known-good pattern: catpage-<BRAND>MS.html e.g. catpage-ALTRAMS.html
known_good_urls: WebFetch works for both URLs above (2026-11-24)
gotchas: Category grid prices disagree with product pages in BOTH directions. Confirmed 2026-09-09: grid said Torin 8 White/Blue $79.88, PDP said $99.88.
'Compare at' figures are algorithmic anchors, not MSRP ($263, $266, $272, $183.09, $158). Use the struck-through price shown, or manufacturer list.
Per-size stock IS server-rendered. Plain fetch works.

OPEN QUESTION: a Haiku subagent reported an 'Extra 20% Off in Cart' badge on 11 SKUs on 2026-09-09. User verified in cart that no discount applied. Cause was a leading extraction prompt. Never re-introduce that phrasing. Determine independently whether such a badge renders at all.

2026-11-22: catpage-ALTRAMS grid shows Clearance -N% tags and struck prices; PDP size selector lists only sizes in stock/sold out (no 12/12.5/13 on Altra clearance). Grid struck price absent on PDP. Black Friday drawer lists brand offers.
2026-11-23: plain curl to catpage-ALTRAMS.html returned HTTP 406 (browser UA + Accept headers); WebFetch not tried.

2026-11-24: curl (browser UA) to catpage-ALTRAMS.html returned 406 again, but WebFetch of the same URL and of the Paradigm 8 PDP worked. Use WebFetch for Running Warehouse. Grid text shows 'Clearance -N%' tags and struck prices; PDP Paradigm 8 showed only US 10.0 D in stock on Black/White, no struck price in text.

2026-11-25: curl 406 again; WebFetch of catpage-ALTRAMS.html and Paradigm 8 PDP worked. Grid struck prices carry an asterisk footnote ('based on MSRP or Original Selling Price'); PDP shows no struck price. Paradigm 8 PDP: Black/White only US 10.0 D in stock.

2026-11-26: curl 406; WebFetch of catpage-ALTRAMS.html worked and lists Torin 8 / Olympus 6 clearance with struck prices; Paradigm 8 no longer on the grid and PDP descpage-ALPA8W3.html returned 404. Promo drawer 'Black Friday Sales & Gifting! 16 Offers' lists brand offers (HOKA Bondi 9, Saucony, New Balance) - candidate lead for brand pages.

sites.name: Zappos
sites.discount_exposure: men-running-shoes category with percentOff sort. Sitewide code banners appear and vanish (BONUS20 present 09-07 and 09-08, absent 09-09).
gotchas: Per-size stock is JS-rendered. Plain fetch returns 'unreadable' — 11 of 16 PDPs failed 2026-09-09. NEEDS PLAYWRIGHT. This is the single biggest fixable coverage gap.
Per-SKU code eligibility is not observable without a cart. Price at shelf, annotate the code.
2026-11-22: WebFetch of the category URL returned only a Women's title, no listings.

2026-11-23: curl of the category URL returned HTTP 200 (2.1 MB) but the page title is "Women's Shoes" and listings include clogs; URL is not a men's running category. Needs a corrected URL and Playwright (/opt/pw-browsers absent in this environment).
2026-11-24: same men-running-shoes URL again returns title "Women's Shoes" (HTTP 200). URL is wrong; needs rediscovery.
2026-11-26: same URL HTTP 200, title still "Women's Shoes". URL needs rediscovery; Playwright absent.
